import sys

# Helper functions for modular arithmetic
MODULUS_NUM = 10**9 + 7

def extended_gcd(a, m):
    if m == 0:
        return a, 1, 0
    g, y, x = extended_gcd(m, a % m)
    y -= (a // m) * x
    return g, x, y

def mod_inverse(a, m=MODULUS_NUM):
    g, x, _ = extended_gcd(a, m)
    return x % m

def fast_mod(x, m=MODULUS_NUM):
    return x % m

class modNumber:
    def __init__(self, val_in=0):
        self.v = val_in % MODULUS_NUM

    def __iadd__(self, other):
        self.v = (self.v + other.v) % MODULUS_NUM
        return self

    def __isub__(self, other):
        self.v = (self.v - other.v) % MODULUS_NUM
        return self

    def __imul__(self, other):
        self.v = (self.v * other.v) % MODULUS_NUM
        return self

    def __itruediv__(self, other):
        self.v = (self.v * modNumber.inverse(other.v)) % MODULUS_NUM
        return self

    def __add__(self, other):
        res = modNumber(self.v)
        res += other
        return res

    def __sub__(self, other):
        res = modNumber(self.v)
        res -= other
        return res

    def __mul__(self, other):
        res = modNumber(self.v)
        res *= other
        return res

    def __truediv__(self, other):
        res = modNumber(self.v)
        res /= other
        return res

    def __neg__(self):
        return modNumber(0) if self.v == 0 else modNumber(MODULUS_NUM - self.v)

    def __eq__(self, other):
        return self.v == other.v

    def __ne__(self, other):
        return self.v != other.v

    def pow(self, p):
        assert p >= 0
        result = modNumber(1)
        base = modNumber(self.v)
        while p > 0:
            if p & 1:
                result *= base
            base *= base
            p >>= 1
        return result
